lessons.title: I and he
lessons.welcome: Our capybara meets helpful friends. Read words about ourselves and other people.

characters.hint: Notice the slanting hook and crossing strokes in 我.

words.sentence: 我们一起画一张地图。
words.translation: We draw a map together.

words.sentence: 这张卡片上写着我的自我介绍。
words.translation: This card has my self-introduction on it.

characters.hint: Find 亻 on the left and 也 on the right of 他.

words.sentence: 我们玩游戏时，也要照顾他人。
words.translation: When we play games, we also look after other people.

words.sentence: 其他小朋友在桌边画画。
words.translation: The other children are drawing at the table.

lessons.title: You and she
lessons.welcome: Greet a new friend and see how she packs her school bag. Compare 你 and 她.

characters.hint: Notice the narrow 亻 on the left of 你.

words.sentence: 见到新朋友，我先说你好。
words.translation: When I meet a new friend, I say hello first.

words.sentence: 你们想坐在树下吗？
words.translation: Would you like to sit under the tree?

characters.hint: Compare the left side 女 in 她 with the left side of 他.

words.sentence: 她们一起把纸花贴好。
words.translation: They stick the paper flowers in place together.

words.sentence: 她自己把书包收拾好了。
words.translation: She packs her school bag herself.

lessons.title: It and they
lessons.welcome: Watch the kitten and ducklings. Compare words for it and words for more than one.

characters.hint: Notice the roof-shaped 宀 at the top of 它.

words.sentence: 两只小鸭来了，它们在水里游。
words.translation: Two ducklings arrive; they swim in the water.

words.sentence: 小猫醒了，它自己走到门口。
words.translation: The kitten wakes up and walks to the doorway by itself.

characters.meaning: plural marker for people and pronouns
characters.hint: Find 亻 beside the door-shaped 门 in 们.

words.sentence: 我们给小树浇水。
words.translation: We water the little tree.

words.sentence: 他们把积木放回盒子里。
words.translation: They put the blocks back into the box.

lessons.title: Whose book is it?
lessons.welcome: Our capybara sorts books. Read a phrase that shows whose book it is, then a word that joins ideas.

characters.hint: Notice 白 on the left of 的; practise 的 in a whole phrase.

words.sentence: 这是我的书。
words.translation: This is my book.

words.sentence: 你的雨伞放在门边。
words.translation: Your umbrella is beside the door.

characters.hint: Notice 日 at the top and the long lower stroke of 是.

words.sentence: 我想出去玩，可是外面下雨了。
words.translation: I want to play outside, but it is raining.

words.sentence: 小猫找到了垫子，于是躺下休息。
words.translation: The kitten finds a cushion, so it lies down to rest.

lessons.title: Have it or not
lessons.welcome: Our capybara checks a useful ruler and tries a knot. Read words about having and not being able to do something.

characters.hint: Notice the crossing top strokes above 月 in 有.

words.sentence: 这把小尺子很有用。
words.translation: This little ruler is useful.

words.sentence: 所有小朋友都拿到了一张纸。
words.translation: All the children get a sheet of paper.

characters.hint: Notice the top horizontal stroke and the two spreading strokes in 不.

words.sentence: 我还不会打这个结，请你教我。
words.translation: I cannot tie this knot yet; please teach me.

words.sentence: 这根绳子太短了，用它不行。
words.translation: This string is too short; it will not do.

lessons.title: Here and this
lessons.welcome: Tidy the table with our capybara. Read words for now and this.

characters.meaning: at; located at; action in progress
characters.hint: Find 土 at the lower right of 在.

words.sentence: 现在我们把桌子收拾好。
words.translation: Now we tidy the table.

words.sentence: 表演开始时，老师也在场。
words.translation: The teacher is also present when the performance starts.

characters.hint: Follow the long bottom stroke of 辶 in 这.

words.sentence: 这个盒子里装着铅笔。
words.translation: This box holds pencils.

words.sentence: 把纸这样折，就能做出一只小船。
words.translation: Fold the paper this way to make a little boat.

lessons.title: That one and which one
lessons.welcome: Choose a school bag and a colour with our capybara. Read words for that and which.

characters.hint: Notice the right-hand 阝 in 那.

words.sentence: 那个书包挂在椅子上。
words.translation: That school bag hangs on the chair.

words.sentence: 我也想做一个那样的风筝。
words.translation: I want to make a kite like that too.

characters.hint: Find 口 beside 那 in 哪.

words.sentence: 你把水杯放在哪里了？
words.translation: Where did you put the drinking cup?

words.sentence: 你想选哪个颜色？
words.translation: Which colour would you like to choose?

lessons.title: Who and what
lessons.welcome: Our capybara asks whose umbrella it is and what to draw. Read two useful question characters.

characters.hint: Find 讠 on the left of 谁; the selected reading here is shéi.

words.sentence: 我以为盒子空了，谁知里面还有积木。
words.translation: I thought the box was empty; who would have thought there were still blocks inside?

words.sentence: 这是谁的雨伞？
words.translation: Whose umbrella is this?

characters.hint: Notice 亻 beside 十 in 什; use shén in 什么.

words.sentence: 你想画什么？
words.translation: What would you like to draw?

words.sentence: 为什么小猫躲在桌子下面？
words.translation: Why is the kitten hiding under the table?

lessons.title: How can we do it?
lessons.welcome: Help our capybara open a box and fold paper. Notice two characters in question words.

characters.hint: Notice the small bent shape at the bottom of 么; practise it in a whole word.

words.sentence: 雨停了，那么我们去公园吧。
words.translation: The rain has stopped; in that case, let us go to the park.

words.sentence: 这个纸盒怎么打开？
words.translation: How do we open this paper box?

characters.hint: Notice 心 below the top part of 怎.

words.sentence: 我们怎么把纸船放进水里？
words.translation: How do we put the paper boat into the water?

words.sentence: 怎样折纸才能做出一个小盒子？
words.translation: How can we fold paper to make a little box?

lessons.title: Reasons and friendship
lessons.welcome: Read about staying indoors and friends making up. Notice the selected readings of 为 and 和.

characters.hint: Notice the crossing strokes in 为; these words use wèi.

words.sentence: 因为下雨，我们在屋里看书。
words.translation: Because it is raining, we read indoors.

words.sentence: 为了不吓到小鸟，我们站得远一点。
words.translation: To avoid frightening the little bird, we stand a little farther away.

characters.hint: Find 禾 beside 口 in 和; these words use hé.

words.sentence: 故事里的村子终于迎来了和平。
words.translation: The village in the story finally welcomes peace.

words.sentence: 两个朋友说清楚以后，就和好了。
words.translation: After the two friends talk things through, they make up.
